newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - June 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - June 10.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Tuesday:
WASHINGTON - Software giant Microsoft Corp said it will invest $1 billion in cable operator Comcast Corp.
WASHINGTON - EchoStar Communications Corp and Rupert Murdoch's News Corp are now trading charges and countercharges after their partnership in satellite operations fell apart in April.

WASHINGTON - Tax changes offered by House Ways and Means Committee chairman Bill Archer would create an enormous range of winners and losers, from Wall Street to Main Street and from bread truck drivers to Indian tribes.
WASHINGTON - Giant Food Inc.'s market share in the Washington area dropped two percentage points in the year ended in March to the lowest level in more than a decade.
